description: This file contains test functions for roundtrip serialization/deserialization of Kubernetes API objects, including test case generation and validation logic.

methods.name: RoundTripTest
methods.description: Runs roundtrip tests for a given scheme and codecs, generating test cases and executing them.

methods.name: GetRoundtripTestCases
methods.description: Generates a list of test cases for each combination of input/output versions and test data directories based on the scheme.

methods.name: roundTrip
methods.description: Performs serialization and deserialization of an object, verifying integrity and matching output files.
